tests.notes: Current integrated HEAD 532c9e6: 43 backend tests passed in 5.59s, including 22 independently owned acceptance tests; the focused independent suite passed 22 tests in 6.36s; and 12 agentic regressions passed in 15.67s. Static OpenAPI validation, DEMO-001 task/report validation, compilation of the independent and backend remediation test modules, diff hygiene, and tester scope all passed. No tests were skipped, xfailed, flaky, or retried. Tests were deliberately credential-free: they did not load .env or invoke live Vertex AI. Independent REPEAT-001 cases prove a single complete unique item has neither signals nor missing evidence; an otherwise matching item with one valid plus one missing Coverage-reference slot is excluded from exact-duplicate grouping and records canonical missing evidence; and multiple opaque repetition groups receive stable IDs in rule-key order despite unsorted item input. Independent endpoint cases prove a 600-character fact is returned unchanged while its evidence summary is ellipsized to exactly 500 characters, a high-precision supported Decimal is returned as the exact canonical string and survives json.dumps(..., allow_nan=false), and Decimal('1e999') produces the sanitized EXTRACTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED HTTP 500 with model_called=false and zero summarizer calls. Existing independent coverage continues to prove exact 0.01 versus 0.0101 arithmetic, frozen Tukey values, evidence resolution, fixed-loader errors, model zero/one-call behavior, output/citation rejection, and real-response OpenAPI validity. Review of the exact remediation confirmed the implementation uses complete Coverage-reference slots for duplicate signatures, bounded Decimal arithmetic/text and evidence summaries, and no contract/trust-boundary expansion. Documentation now correctly delegates lifecycle state to task.json and describes the 30-second/2,048-token limits as fixed source-controlled constants rather than environment variables.
